reviewMethod: Read each of the 21 current occurrences through its complete encounter, address, biography, or compilation unit rather than inheriting the prior verdict.
Asked who uttered the exact headword-bearing words; a later raiser, record owner, compiler, questioner, respondent, and acting subject were kept distinct.
Ran zc.verify on every current KWIC and required returned FromLb and ToLb to equal the stored span; every selected normalized span occurs once in its file.
Compared all seven rows within each entry for duplicate evidence, then reread the current opening, sense boundary, and depth against the cases.
